rtl_result.summary: Implemented the frozen single-module accelerator, including synchronous retained memories, 8x8 MAC array, tiled scheduling, and stalled output handling.

files.purpose: Complete parameterized tiled INT8 fully connected accelerator.

contract_checks.evidence: One file implements tiled_int8_fc with all declared ports and the three original parameters; no helper modules.

contract_checks.requirement: Signed arithmetic and fixed parallel array
contract_checks.evidence: 64 generated cells form exact signed 16-bit products and explicitly truncate accumulator sums to 32 bits; scalar bias addition wraps before ReLU.

contract_checks.requirement: Retained storage and synchronous read timing
contract_checks.evidence: Three parameter-sized memories have mutually exclusive writes and registered reads; request states precede capture/finalize states.
FSM uses one clear cycle, eight request/capture pairs plus one MAC per k, and bias-request/finalize/emit per result, without overlap.

Widths are clamped to at least one bit; address/count arithmetic uses unsigned 32-bit intermediates. Independent operand masks and four-bit tile extents omit invalid results. Static parameter guards reject bounds outside 1..1024.
Loads advance only on input acceptance; EMIT holds payload and coordinates until acceptance. Traversal is tm, tn, local row, local column; final acceptance pulses done.

Reset gates transfers/status and clears control/output state without clearing memories, read registers, lanes, or accumulators. Textual review found no incomplete combinational assignments or overlapping register drivers.

known_risks: Compilation, simulation, and synthesis have not run; full regression is required.
Tool support for the standard SystemVerilog elaboration-time $error parameter guard requires verification.
Vivado handoff requires an explicitly supplied target part and clock/I/O constraints.
